50758509.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to full length recombinant human biotin-labeled KHK by SPR assay

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Surface Plasmon Resonance Experiments. Experiments were performed on a Fujifilm AP-3000 instrument. Full length biotinylated KHK was captured onto a SA-101 Fujifilm sensor stick to levels ranging from 7000 to 8000 RU. Compound binding experiments were performed in 50 mM HEPES, pH 7.4, 150 mM NaCl, 0.01% P20, 500 μM TCEP, and 3% DMSO at 25 °C. Binding responses were processed using Spotfire software (TIBCO) to zero, x-align, double reference, and correct for excluded volume effects of DMSO in the data. Experiments were carried out for 11 compound concentrations with 2-fold dilutions and a top compound concentration of 300 μM.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. Representative structures of KHK inhibitors from the pyrimidinopyrimidine and indazole series reported in the literature.

analyte.description: Compounds tested for binding to KHK
analyte.concentration_range: 11 concentrations with 2-fold dilutions, top concentration 300 μM

assay_conditions.running_buffer_composition: 50 mM HEPES, 150 mM NaCl, 0.01% P20, 500 μM TCEP, 3% DMSO
